title: Wicked
article:
Many people have heard of Wicked, the gravity defying musical that’s run for over 20 years; perhaps you’ve seen it. But before it was a musical it was a book and most recently it became a movie. The history of Wicked is much more than a musical.

Gregory Magurine wrote Wicked: The Life and Times of the Wicked Witch in 1995. It is the first in a tetralogy, the others being: Son of the Witch, A Lion Among Men, and Out of Oz. This story is based on the backstory of The Wicked Witch, the villain, from L. Frank Baum's best selling book, the Wizard of Oz. This book chronicles the life of Elphaba, a misunderstood green skinned witch, and her unlikely friendship with Glinda the “Good Witch.”

Wicked, the musical, is more famous however, premiering in 2003 and winning 3 Tony Awards and 7 Drama Desk Awards. This hit musical, the fourth longest Broadway show, is known for its catchy and dramatic songs. In its twenty plus years of shows, Wicked the Musical has become a staple on Broadway. Its premise is mostly the same but the plot was simplified and made more family friendly.

On November 22nd, Wicked, the movie was released. It stars Ariana Grande as Glinda and Cynthia Erivo as Elphaba, with cameo appearances from Idina Menzel and Kristin Chenoweth (the original actresses). According to Rotten Tomatoes, “Fly, do not run, to see Wicked, a bewitching musical experience enchanted by a spellbinding cast.” However, Wicked the movie, as of 2024, is only one part of the ultimate two part movie. The second part will be released November 2025.

In conclusion, Wicked’s history as a book, musical and now movie has only added to the rich world of Glinda and Elphaba.
author: Ava Samuels
